heading: General rule for voluntarily negotiated agreements
lead: Any rates or terms under this title that— shall remain in effect for such period of time as would otherwise apply under such determination, except that the Copyright Royalty Judges shall adjust the rates pursuant to the voluntary negotiations to reflect national monetary inflation during the additional period the rates remain in effect.
